general.sampleIntervalHint: Controls the refresh rate for live network, CPU, and memory data.

about.lhmAttribution: Hardware sensor data is provided by LibreHardwareMonitorLib, with low-level access via WinRing0. Both are licensed under MPL 2.0.

admin.notElevatedDesc: Hardware sensor reading and fan control require administrator privileges. The packaged build auto-requests UAC elevation; this is a dev-mode launch without elevation, so some sensors may be unavailable and fan control will not work.
